items.title: PostgreSQL 17 local dev + DATABASE_URL
acceptanceCriteria: README or progress.md notes connection verified

items.title: Drizzle ORM setup + migration scripts
acceptanceCriteria: bun run db:migrate applies cleanly on empty local DB
db:generate and db:seed scripts in package.json

items.title: Core schema migration (orgs, customers, dossiers, declarations)
acceptanceCriteria: All MVP tables from 06-data-model exist with organization_id
Indexes and uniques on dossier_number, declaration_number per org

items.title: Better Auth + organization plugin + Drizzle adapter
acceptanceCriteria: Session available in server components / actions

items.title: Tenancy helpers (requireOrg, organizationId on queries)
acceptanceCriteria: Cross-org access impossible in service layer tests or manual check

items.title: Dev seed script (pilot-shaped data)
acceptanceCriteria: 1 org, agencies, 3 clients with slugs, 4 declarations (1 BL each)
Pilot fields: zone, containers, montant, GAINDE, prix de revient, bon à délivrer
bun run db:seed idempotent when demo-transit exists

items.title: Pilot operations schema (migration 0003)
acceptanceCriteria: declarations: zone, filing amounts, bon_a_delivrer, paying_agency_id
customers: slug, account_status; ledger: balance_side, versement, notes
items.notes: Migration 0004 adds year-scoped sequences and partial unique on dossiers.bl_reference.

items.title: shadcn/ui + Tailwind app shell baseline
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated layout with app shell (tab nav via UI-004)

items.title: Declarations module (BL row CRUD, containers, bon à délivrer, edit log)
acceptanceCriteria: updateDeclaration writes declaration_edit_log on tracked field changes
Optional FSM transitionStatus when DOM-001 done

items.title: Customers module
acceptanceCriteria: CRUD customers with slug from name
List: solde as amount + debit/credit side (agency view)
Computed: day-open report, transactions today (Africa/Dakar), all-time cost_price sum

items.title: Ledger module (versements, débit/crédit, allocations)
acceptanceCriteria: Immutable entries; reversal only; amount always positive
No report entry type — day-open balance is computed query

items.title: Activity module
acceptanceCriteria: appendActivity called from declaration, ledger, dossier flows

items.title: Documents module (R2 presign — or local stub)
acceptanceCriteria: Dev stub acceptable before R2 wired

items.title: App sidebar: Déclarations, Clients, Réglages (nav only)
acceptanceCriteria: No create CTA in sidebar (moved to PageHeader — UI-003)

items.title: Shell IA: PageHeader + contextual CTAs
acceptanceCriteria: PageHeader component with title, description, actions slot

items.title: IA v2: horizontal tab nav + dashboard landing
acceptanceCriteria: Tab order: Tableau de bord, Déclarations, Clients, Réglages
Dashboard stub with synthèse / à faire / activité récente sections
Active tab via pathname match incl. nested routes
items.notes: Supersedes UI-002 sidebar pattern. Data wiring for dashboard sections in POL-002.

items.title: Theme switcher (Clair / Sombre / Système)
acceptanceCriteria: next-themes ThemeProvider on root layout (class attribute, default light, system allowed)
Profile menu Apparence: Clair, Sombre, Système

items.title: Declarations list page (/declarations)
acceptanceCriteria: Table: N° décl., Dossier, Client, Statut, N° douane, BL
View presets: Tous, En cours, Clôturées (minimal)
PageHeader CTA retained (UI-003); filters below header
items.notes: Table + toolbar: presets Tous/En cours/BAD coché, client/zone/search/period, URL sync, sort, Reste column. Deferred: customs status + N° douane columns.

items.title: New declaration form (/declarations/new)
acceptanceCriteria: Client select; new vs existing dossier
Creates dossier + initial declaration by default

items.title: Declaration fiche (/declarations/[id])
acceptanceCriteria: Dossier context card with link to dossier hub
items.notes: Résumé + Historique tabs, dossier card, inline edit form. Missing: customs FSM stepper (DECL-004), Activité feed from activity_log.

items.title: Status change sheet (FSM UI)
acceptanceCriteria: Error message in French on invalid transition

items.title: Edit declaration + rectificative audit log UI
acceptanceCriteria: Edit filing fields in place (montant, GAINDE, prix de revient, containers, …)
items.notes: EditDeclarationForm + Historique timeline + setBonADelivrer; org-scoped refs validated in service.

items.title: Dossier hub page (/dossiers/[id])
items.notes: Minimal page: dossier header + linked declarations list. Missing: tabbed hub, documents, finances, close dossier.

items.title: Clients list + fiche (/clients)
items.notes: Résumé tab = journal du compte (transactions + déclarations, solde après chaque écriture, par jour). Remaining: optional dedicated Activité tab from activity_log, list polish.

items.title: Payment + allocation UI
acceptanceCriteria: Allocate to one or more dossiers
items.notes: Unified transaction form (credit/debit types) on Transactions tab + /transactions; multi-dossier allocations for credit types; extensible org transaction types.

items.title: Opening balance + reversal UI
acceptanceCriteria: Opening balance entry on client create or comptabilité
items.notes: New client optional opening balance; fiche dialog; contre-passation on transactions tab; system types hidden from normal record form.

items.title: Global search (Cmd+K)
acceptanceCriteria: Search declaration #, dossier #, client name, BL, customs ref

items.title: Actionable dashboard (/dashboard data wiring)
acceptanceCriteria: Synthèse cards: déclarations en cours, dossiers ouverts, soldes à surveiller
À faire queue: stale declarations, overdue solde, dossiers ready to close
Activité récente: unified timeline (last N events) with links to source entities

items.title: Neon staging + Vercel preview deploy
acceptanceCriteria: Migrations run in CI or deploy hook
items.notes: Use local Postgres 17 until core flows work; Neon when ready for external pilot.

items.title: Reconcile Better Auth org tables vs app organizations
acceptanceCriteria: Single tenancy model documented and enforced
Unused organization/member/invitation tables dropped or synced

items.title: Proxy full session validation (Next.js 16)
acceptanceCriteria: proxy.ts validates session via auth.api.getSession, not cookie presence only

items.title: Seed partial-failure recovery
acceptanceCriteria: If org exists but business tables empty, seed completes demo data

acceptanceCriteria: Tests for sanitizeRedirectPath, requireAuthContext org scoping, disableSignUp
